_FIELD_TEST_ONLY: BRANCH feat/moss-0.16-dev.11 -- DO NOT MERGE TO main-0.7.
The 'holochain' and 'hc' entries in this file are NOT the stock holochain 0.7.1
release artifacts. They are PATCHED binaries carrying the kitsune2 hello/PoK
access module plus mDNS LAN discovery, built from lightningrodlabs/holochain
branch moss-0.16-0.7.1 at commit dfde303aedcd69d66aa3219cc9b9cbe85185978c
(kitsune2 branch moss-0.16, rev c18c46536bb19ac6416fe1db13e8122f93f39345: upstream
kitsune2 main plus the hello/PoK and mDNS work, on iroh 1.4.1), published as the fork release
lightningrodlabs/holochain @ holochain-0.7.1-mdns.7. The `binarySources` block
below is what repoints the fetch at that release.
mdns.7 keeps HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002, so hello.2 and every mdns.* node interoperate.
Patched nodes advertise HCP2P_PROTO_VER=1002 and reject stock peers at preflight,
so a build made from this branch CANNOT see stock Moss on the network. That is
deliberate -- it isolates the field-test cohort -- but it means every installer
handed to a tester must be built from this branch, and the release notes must say
so. See RUNBOOK-fieldtest.md.
'lair-keystore' and 'kitsune2-bootstrap-srv' are UNPATCHED. They have no
binarySources entry and therefore still come from the stock
holochain/holochain @ holochain-0.7.1 release. Do not add one.
NOTE: `yarn update-hc-checksums` regenerates this file from GitHub release assets
and will destroy this note, the binarySources block, and the patched checksums.

All ten holochain/hc checksums are from the fork release lightningrodlabs/holochain @ holochain-0.7.1-mdns.7 checksums-sha256.txt (workflow run 40587054326, holochain commit dfde303a, kitsune2 rev c18c4653), matched against the GitHub asset digests.

mdns.7 is Holochain 0.7.1 on iroh 1.4.1, with the fix that stops every zome call from loading the whole source chain for the zome-init check (init result cached per cell, source chain queries filtered in SQL), (kitsune2 iroh/iroh-relay/iroh-base/iroh-dns 1.4.1, iroh-mdns-address-lookup 0.6.1) plus the capability grant wire fix from holochain/holochain#6042 (still unmerged upstream), so DNAs built against hdk 0.7.0 and hdk 0.7.1 both run. A profile opened by this build cannot be reopened by a 0.7.0 build: 0.7.1 adds DHT database migrations that 0.7.0 refuses (sqlx VersionMissing).
